title: Design Engineer I - ACHE
jobDescription: CHART INDUSTRIES, INC. (Chart) (NYSE: GTLS) is a leading independent global manufacturer of highly engineered equipment and services related to cryogenic gas processing and rotating equipment. In the cryogenic sector, the Chart brand is synonymous with the liquefaction, distribution, and storage of liquid gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, LNG, biogas, hydrogen, helium, and carbon dioxide. The acquisition of Howden expanded our portfolio to include air and gas handling products such as compressors, cooling fans, steam turbines, and more, expanding our offering of products and solutions across traditional markets and providing access to new ones such as nuclear, energy recovery, tunnel ventilation, mine safety, and electrification. - Design and develop air-cooled heat exchangers based on project requirements, client specifications, and industry standards. - Develop and review detailed 3D models and 2D engineering drawings with correct GD&T. - Select finned tubes, headers, tube layouts, fan configurations, and structural components based on thermal and mechanical considerations. - Execute mechanical design calculations for components (tube thickness, header design, vibration analysis, thermal stresses). - Review and interpret process data sheets, PFDs/P&IDs, and client design parameters. - Coordinate with process engineers on thermal requirements, air-side heat transfer, and optimization of exchanger configuration. - Support thermal design tools (HTRI or equivalent) during process–mechanical integration. - Ensure compliance with codes and standards such as TEMA, ASME, API, and project-specific specifications. - Prepare and maintain design documents: datasheets, GA drawings, fabrication drawings, specifications, test plans, and inspection checklists. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams—process, structural, electrical, instrumentation, QA/QC, and project management—to ensure smooth execution. - Extracting bill of materials from drawing and uploading into the ERP system. - Generating specification documents for bought out items. - Support manufacturing team to troubleshoot non-conformities, in the eventuality of such occurrences. - Ensure that designs comply with relevant industrial standards such as API, ASME. - Optimization of design to reduce the cost. - Active participation in continuous improvement and new product development. - Knowledge of supplier base will add advantage. - B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering. - 3 to 7 years of relevant experience. - 3D drafting skills in Autocad, Autodesk Inventor & Ansys. - Understanding of ACHE/ACHX components: finned tubes, tube bundles, headers, fans, louvers, and structures. - Knowledge of thermal and mechanical design software (HTRI, PV Elite/Compress). - Familiarity with TEMA, ASME Sec VIII, API standards for exchangers - Ability to interpret P&IDs, engineering datasheets, and material specifications - Excellent communications skills both verbal and written. - Ability to plan, direct and control at an operational level. - Ability to work to tight deadlines. - Excellent team player - Proactive and able to work on own initiative.

title: Assistant Manager/Manager - Engineering
jobDescription: Ensuring Chart’s Success… Chart Industries is a leading global manufacturer of highly engineered equipment and solutions serving multiple applications in the Energy, Industrial, and Industrial Gas end markets. In March 2023 Chart Industries acquired the Howden Group, and the combined group is now represented in over 40 countries worldwide with over 11,700 employees. Our vision is to enable the vital processes of our customers and thereby promote a more sustainable world via our Nexus of Clean™ strategy. The combination of Chart and Howden furthers our global leadership position in process technologies with products and services in applications such as hydrogen, carbon capture, energy recovery, nuclear, water treatment, mining, and LNG to name a few. Together with customer-focused service solutions including an extensive service network and market-leading digital diagnostics, we support our customers through the complete lifecycle of their assets. At Chart we have a strong corporate identity and a clear purpose - you will be a member of our team shaping the future of the company and participating in helping our customers and the world tackle some of the planet's most pressing issues.
